title: ActionRequest
description: A request from the Intelligence Service to the Action Service to perform a remediation.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this specific action request.

incident_event_id.description: ID of the incident that triggered this action.

action_id.description: ID of the pre-approved action to execute (e.g., 'restart_pod', 'clear_cache').

target.description: The specific resource to act upon (e.g., 'pod-xyz', 'db-primary').

parameters.description: Key-value arguments for the action script. Must be validated against the action's specific schema.

confidence_score.description: The AI's confidence level in this recommendation.

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this action was chosen.

requires_approval.description: Whether human approval is mandated by policy.
